entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose
entries.text: Define classic color reset, background opacity modes, safe shape rendering, and external image presentation.

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Classic color reset tool
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供一鍵重置為經典配色的工具，讓使用者快速整理節點色彩。

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Classic color reset tool > Scenario: 重置為經典配色
entries.text:
- **GIVEN** 使用者在視覺模式工具列
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊「重置配色」按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 根據節點的 BFS 深度，重新套用預設的經典配色到所有無手動自訂顏色的概念節點
- **AND** 已有手動自訂顏色的概念節點與便利貼節點不受影響
- **AND** 此操作 SHALL 被記錄到 undo 歷史中

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Dark mode solid background toggle
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供節點背景透明度切換，解決暗色模式下半透明節點不可辨識的問題。

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Dark mode solid background toggle > Scenario: 切換為純色背景
entries.text:
- **GIVEN** 知識圖目前使用半透明背景（`translucent`）
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊工具列的「背景模式」切換按鈕
- **THEN** 所有概念節點的背景 SHALL 從 `${color}15`（約 8% 不透明度）變為 `${color}CC`（約 80% 不透明度）
- **AND** `GraphDocument.backgroundOpacity` SHALL 更新為 `'solid'`

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Dark mode solid background toggle > Scenario: 暗色模式下新建圖表預設值
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 系統偵測到使用者處於暗色模式（`dark` class 在 `<html>` 上）
- **AND** 使用者建立一張新的知識圖
- **THEN** `backgroundOpacity` SHALL 預設為 `'solid'`

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Fix diamond shape rendering
entries.text: 菱形節點 SHALL 正確渲染為 45° 旋轉的外框，而非被 `rotate-45` 拉長的膠囊形狀。

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Fix diamond shape rendering > Scenario: 菱形節點正確顯示
entries.text:
- **GIVEN** 使用者將一個節點設為「菱形」形狀
- **WHEN** 畫布渲染該節點
- **THEN** 節點外框 SHALL 呈現為正菱形（45° 旋轉的正方形，使用 clip-path 實現）
- **AND** 節點內部的文字 SHALL 水平排列（不旋轉）
- **AND** 節點上的 Handle（連接點）SHALL 正確定位在菱形的上/下頂點

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Purpose > Requirement: Fix diamond shape rendering > Scenario: 菱形節點的點擊區域
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊菱形節點的可見菱形區域內
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 正確識別為點擊該節點
- **AND** 菱形外部的透明區域點擊 SHALL NOT 選中該節點

entries.heading: Spec: Graph Visual Themes > Verification
entries.text:
- 視覺驗證：驗證菱形節點在亮色/暗色模式下的渲染，保證文字水平居中不旋轉
- 單元測試：驗證 `graphStorage` 的 schema v3 遷移中 `backgroundOpacity` 預設值正確
- `npm run build` 通過
- `npm test` 通過

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Purpose
entries.text: TBD - created by archiving change security-architecture-hardening-v2. Update Purpose after archive.

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Requirements > Requirement: useKeyboardShortcuts binds listener once via handlers ref
entries.text:
`useKeyboardShortcuts` hook SHALL 採用 `useRef` 包裹回調集合以解耦監聽器生命週期與回調參考變化。`handlersRef = useRef({ onSelectOption, onSubmitOrNext, onToggleHint, onExit })` SHALL 在每次渲染被更新（透過獨立的 `useEffect` 無依賴陣列或於 render body 中直接賦值）。註冊 `window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)` 的 `useEffect` SHALL 依賴陣列為空 `[]`，全生命週期只綁定一次監聽器，回調透過 `handlersRef.current` 呼叫。

isEditableTarget 防護（偵測 `INPUT` / `TEXTAREA` / `SELECT` / `contentEditable` / `role='textbox'`）SHALL 完整保留，以避免在 AI helper 輸入框等可編輯欄位劫持按鍵。外部呼叫介面（`useKeyboardShortcuts({ ...callbacks })` 的 props shape）SHALL 不變。

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Requirements > Requirement: useKeyboardShortcuts binds listener once via handlers ref > Scenario: Listener binds once across re-renders
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `QuizCard` 因 quiz state 變更多次重新渲染
- **AND** 每次渲染傳入新的 `onSelectOption` / `onSubmitOrNext` 函式參考
- **THEN** `window.addEventListener('keydown', ...)` SHALL 只被呼叫一次（mount 時）
- **AND** `window.removeEventListener` SHALL 只在 unmount 時被呼叫一次
- **AND** 新的回調 SHALL 透過 `handlersRef.current` 即時被新事件觸發呼叫

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Requirements > Requirement: useKeyboardShortcuts binds listener once via handlers ref > Scenario: Number key triggers handler through ref
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者按下數字鍵 `1`
- **AND** `handlersRef.current.onSelectOption` 指向最新的 `onSelectOption` 回調
- **THEN** `handlersRef.current.onSelectOption(0)` SHALL 被呼叫
- **AND** 行為 SHALL 與原 hook 等價

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Requirements > Requirement: useKeyboardShortcuts binds listener once via handlers ref > Scenario: Editable target guard preserved
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 焦點位於 `<input>` / `<textarea>` / `<select>` 元素
- **AND** 使用者按下 `1`
- **THEN** 監聽器 SHALL 提前 return（不呼叫任何 handler）
- **AND** 鍵盤事件 SHALL NOT 被 `preventDefault`
- **AND** 既有 textarea 輸入行為 SHALL 不被劫持

entries.heading: keyboard-shortcuts-stability Specification > Requirements > Requirement: useKeyboardShortcuts binds listener once via handlers ref > Scenario: Enter/H/Esc keys route through ref
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者按下 `Enter` / `h` / `H` / `Escape`
- **THEN** 對應的 `handlersRef.current.onSubmitOrNext` / `onToggleHint` / `onExit` SHALL 被呼叫
- **AND** 行為 SHALL 與原 hook 等價

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > Purpose
entries.text: Define the data structures and storage mechanisms for visual knowledge diagrams, ensuring efficient persistence and system-wide data integrity.

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph data model definition
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 定義 `GraphDocument`、`GraphNode`、`GraphEdge`、`GraphViewState` 四個核心型別，作為知識圖的主資料結構。GraphDocument SHALL 包含唯一 id（UUID）、名稱、節點陣列、邊陣列、視圖狀態、建立時間和更新時間。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph data model definition > Scenario: GraphDocument 型別完整性
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 開發者建立一個新的 GraphDocument 物件
- **THEN** 物件 MUST 包含 id (string)、name (string)、nodes (GraphNode[])、edges (GraphEdge[])、viewState (GraphViewState)、createdAt (string)、updatedAt (string) 所有欄位

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph data model definition > Scenario: GraphNode 型別包含三層內容
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 建立一個 GraphNode
- **THEN** node.data MUST 包含 title (string, 必填)、definition (string, 選填)、details (string, 選填)、color (string)、fontSize ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg')

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph localStorage persistence
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 將所有圖表資料儲存於 localStorage key `mindspark_graphs`，格式為 JSON 序列化的 `GraphDocument[]`。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph localStorage persistence > Scenario: 儲存圖表至 localStorage
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者建立或修改一個圖表
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將完整的 GraphDocument 序列化為 JSON 並寫入 `mindspark_graphs` key

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph localStorage persistence > Scenario: 從 localStorage 載入圖表
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者進入知識圖工作區
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 從 `mindspark_graphs` key 讀取並反序列化所有 GraphDocument

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph localStorage persistence > Scenario: localStorage 不存在
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `mindspark_graphs` key 不存在
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 返回空陣列 `[]`

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph localStorage persistence > Scenario: localStorage 損毀
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `mindspark_graphs` JSON 解析失敗或頂層格式錯誤
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回報可識別的 `PARSE_FAILED` 或 `INVALID_FORMAT` 錯誤
- **AND** SHALL 保留原始資料，不以空陣列靜默覆寫

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph CRUD operations
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供完整的圖表 CRUD 操作：建立、讀取、更新、刪除。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph CRUD operations > Scenario: 建立新圖表
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊「新增圖表」按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 建立一個包含預設名稱、空節點陣列、空邊陣列的新 GraphDocument，並持久化至 localStorage

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph CRUD operations > Scenario: 刪除圖表
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者確認刪除一個圖表
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 從 `mindspark_graphs` 中移除該 GraphDocument 並更新 localStorage

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph CRUD operations > Scenario: 圖表數量上限
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者嘗試建立超過 20 個圖表
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 提示使用者已達上限，建議刪除舊圖表

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Autosave mechanism
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 在每次圖表操作後自動儲存，使用 debounce 策略（2 秒延遲）避免頻繁寫入。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Autosave mechanism > Scenario: 操作後自動儲存
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者新增、移動、編輯或刪除節點/連線
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 在 2 秒無新操作後自動將當前圖表狀態寫入 localStorage

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Autosave mechanism > Scenario: 離開頁面前立即儲存
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者切換 view 或關閉瀏覽器分頁
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 立即（不等待 debounce）將當前狀態寫入 localStorage

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: System nuke integration
entries.text: 系統清除（nuke）功能 SHALL 包含清除 `mindspark_graphs` key。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: System nuke integration > Scenario: 系統清除時刪除圖表資料
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者執行系統清除操作
- **THEN** `mindspark_graphs` key SHALL 被從 localStorage 中移除

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph document rename
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 允許使用者重新命名已建立的圖表文件。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph document rename > Scenario: 重命名圖表
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在文件清單中雙擊圖表名稱或點擊重命名按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示內嵌文字編輯器，允許修改圖表名稱並持久化

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Graph document rename > Scenario: 名稱長度限制
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者輸入超過 50 個字元的圖表名稱
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 截斷至 50 個字元

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: GraphDocument schema v3
entries.text: GraphDocument SHALL 使用 schema version `3`，並包含 `backgroundOpacity`（`translucent` | `solid`）、`layoutMode`（`free` | `radial`）與 `theme` 欄位。GraphNodeData SHALL 支援外部 `imageUrl`、便利貼 `bold` 樣式與使用者自訂顏色標記。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: GraphDocument schema v3 > Scenario: 舊版本資料自動遷移
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 系統載入 schema version 小於 3 的圖表
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 以安全型別守衛讀取資料
- **AND** 補上 `backgroundOpacity: 'translucent'`、`layoutMode: 'free'`、`theme: 'default'`
- **AND** 以 schema version `3` 寫回 localStorage

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: GraphDocument schema v3 > Scenario: 不可信資料不覆寫正式資料
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `mindspark_graphs` JSON 損毀或頂層格式錯誤
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回報可識別的 `PARSE_FAILED` 或 `INVALID_FORMAT` 錯誤
- **AND** SHALL NOT 以空陣列靜默覆寫原資料

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Text field length limits
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 對節點內容欄位設定最大長度限制，防止 localStorage 膨脹。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Text field length limits > Scenario: 標題長度限制
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者輸入超過 100 個字元的節點標題
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 阻止輸入或截斷至 100 個字元

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Text field length limits > Scenario: 定義長度限制
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者輸入超過 500 個字元的節點定義
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 阻止輸入或截斷至 500 個字元

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Text field length limits > Scenario: 補充長度限制
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者輸入超過 2000 個字元的節點補充說明
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 阻止輸入或截斷至 2000 個字元

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: localStorage quota handling
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 妥善處理 localStorage 配額超限的情況。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: localStorage quota handling > Scenario: 儲存時空間不足
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 儲存圖表時觸發 `QuotaExceededError`（透過 `DOMException.name === 'QuotaExceededError'` 或 legacy `DOMException.code === 22` 偵測）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 捕捉錯誤、顯示 Toast 警告使用者儲存空間已滿，建議刪除舊圖表

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Data > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud graph persistence
entries.text: 登入使用者的 GraphDocument SHALL 可同步至 Supabase `knowledge_graphs`，且資料表 SHALL 啟用以 `auth.uid() = user_id` 為條件的 RLS。autosave 在 upsert 前 SHALL 重新檢查雲端時間戳；偵測到雲端較新版本時 SHALL 停止覆寫並標記 dirty。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > Purpose
entries.text: Provide a highly interactive, visual interface for students to construct and manipulate knowledge diagrams using a node-and-link canvas metaphor.

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Visual node editor canvas
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供基於 @xyflow/react 的視覺化節點編輯器畫布，支援節點拖曳、縮放、平移操作。畫布 SHALL 使用受控模式 (Controlled Mode) 與 React state 整合。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Visual node editor canvas > Scenario: 畫布基本互動
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者進入知識圖工作區的編輯模式
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示一個可縮放、可平移的畫布，已存在的節點和連線 SHALL 正確渲染

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Visual node editor canvas > Scenario: 節點拖曳
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在桌面端拖曳一個節點
- **THEN** 節點 SHALL 跟隨滑鼠移動，並在放開後更新座標位置

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node CRUD via toolbar
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供工具列按鈕讓使用者新增和刪除節點。新增的節點 SHALL 出現在畫布中央可見區域。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node CRUD via toolbar > Scenario: 新增節點
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊工具列的「新增節點」按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 在畫布可見區域中央建立一個新節點，預設標題為「新概念」，預設顏色為藍色

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node CRUD via toolbar > Scenario: 刪除選中節點
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者選中一個節點並點擊「刪除」按鈕或按 Delete 鍵
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 刪除該節點及其所有連線

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge creation and deletion
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 支援透過拖曳方式在兩個節點間建立連線，連線預設帶方向箭頭。系統 SHALL 禁止自連線（節點連向自身）。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge creation and deletion > Scenario: 建立帶箭頭連線
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者從一個節點的連接點拖曳到另一個節點
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 建立一條從源節點指向目標節點的帶箭頭連線

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge creation and deletion > Scenario: 禁止自連線
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者嘗試將一個節點的連接點拖曳到同一個節點
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 阻止連線建立，不產生自連線

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge creation and deletion > Scenario: 切換連線箭頭
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者選中一條連線
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 提供選項切換箭頭方向或移除箭頭

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge creation and deletion > Scenario: 刪除連線
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者選中一條連線並按 Delete 鍵執行刪除按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 刪除該連線

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node content editing
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 允許使用者直接在節點上編輯文字內容，支援三層內容結構。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node content editing > Scenario: 編輯節點標題
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者雙擊一個節點
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示內嵌文字編輯器，允許修改標題（Level 1）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node content editing > Scenario: 編輯節點詳細內容
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在節點屬性面板中編輯
- **THEN** 使用者 SHALL 能修改定義（Level 2）和補充說明（Level 3）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node style customization
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供節點樣式自訂功能，包括顏色和字體大小。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node style customization > Scenario: 修改節點顏色
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在屬性面板中選擇新顏色
- **THEN** 節點背景色 SHALL 立即更新為選定顏色

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node style customization > Scenario: 修改節點字體大小
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在屬性面板中切換字體大小（小/中/大）
- **THEN** 節點文字大小 SHALL 立即更新

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node style customization > Scenario: 便利貼文字樣式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者調整便利貼字體大小或粗體
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將設定儲存在 `data.fontSize` 與 `data.bold`，並立即套用至便利貼文字

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Node style customization > Scenario: 外部圖片網址安全驗證
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在屬性面板輸入圖片網址
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 僅接受具有 hostname 的 `http://` 或 `https://` URL
- **AND** 非法 URL SHALL 即時顯示警告，不寫入 GraphNodeData，也不渲染圖片

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Drag-to-create node menu
entries.text: 使用者從 handle 將連線拖至空白畫布時，系統 SHALL 顯示包含方形、圓角、菱形、便利貼的 DropNodeMenu。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Drag-to-create node menu > Scenario: 空白處建立節點
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者選擇 DropNodeMenu 的形狀
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 於 `screenToFlowPosition` 對應位置建立節點、建立帶箭頭連線並記錄 undo
- **AND** 達到 MAX_NODES 或 MAX_EDGES 時 SHALL 顯示警告並阻止變更

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Drag-to-create node menu > Scenario: 關閉 DropNodeMenu
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊選單外部或按 Escape
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 關閉選單且不建立節點

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Layout and visual theme modes
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供 `free` 與 `radial` 兩種佈局模式、背景 `translucent`/`solid` 切換與經典 BFS 配色重設。放射狀佈局 SHALL 使用既有演算法，並保留便利貼位置；自訂顏色 SHALL 不被重設。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Layout and visual theme modes > Scenario: 佈局模式切換
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者切換至 radial
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 重新排列概念節點、保留便利貼位置、更新 `GraphDocument.layoutMode` 並記錄 undo
- **WHEN** 使用者切回 free
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 保留目前位置並允許自由拖曳

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Layout and visual theme modes > Scenario: 暗色模式預設純色背景
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 新建圖表且 `<html>` 具有 `dark` class
- **THEN** `backgroundOpacity` SHALL 預設為 `solid`

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Code/visual mode style preservation
entries.text: 代碼與視覺模式互轉 SHALL 以完整祖先路徑（使用 `:` 分隔）匹配節點，並在路徑失配時以 Levenshtein 距離 ≤ 2、同深度的 heuristic 匹配。匹配 SHALL 保留位置、顏色、形狀、字體、圖片與邊樣式；Markdown SHALL 不包含 UUID。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Code/visual mode style preservation > Scenario: 父節點重命名提示
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在代碼模式編輯圖表
- **THEN** UI SHALL 顯示「重命名父節點會重設其子分支樣式；建議在視覺編輯中重命名以保留樣式。」提示

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge label editing
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 允許使用者為連線添加文字標籤。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge label editing > Scenario: 添加連線標籤
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者雙擊一條連線
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示文字輸入框，允許輸入連線標籤文字

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Toolbar design
entries.text: 工具列 SHALL 採用極簡設計，僅包含核心操作按鈕，避免資訊過載。工具列 SHALL 在手機端隱藏。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Toolbar design > Scenario: 桌面端工具列顯示
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在桌面端（螢幕寬度 > 768px）進入編輯模式
- **THEN** 工具列 SHALL 顯示以下按鈕：新增節點、刪除選中、連線模式切換、匯入 Mermaid、匯出 Mermaid

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Toolbar design > Scenario: 手機端隱藏工具列
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端（螢幕寬度 ≤ 768px）瀏覽知識圖
- **THEN** 編輯工具列 SHALL 隱藏，僅顯示閱讀模式切換按鈕

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement
entries.text: 手機端（≤768px）SHALL 在 mutation layer 層面強制唯讀，不僅僅是隱藏 UI。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement > Scenario: 手機端禁止節點拖曳
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端嘗試拖曳節點
- **THEN** 節點 SHALL 保持原位不移動（`nodesDraggable: false`）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement > Scenario: 手機端禁止連線操作
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端嘗試從節點 handle 拖曳建立連線
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 不啟動連線建立（`nodesConnectable: false`）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement > Scenario: 手機端禁止刪除操作
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端按 Delete 鍵
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 忽略刪除操作（`elementsSelectable: false` 或攔截 delete handler）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement > Scenario: 手機端禁止雙擊編輯
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端雙擊節點或連線
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 不進入編輯模式（不顯示文字輸入框或屬性面板）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile read-only enforcement > Scenario: 手機端允許的操作
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端操作知識圖
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 允許：pan（平移）、pinch-zoom（縮放）、切換閱讀模式、點擊節點展開內容（逐步探索模式）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Properties panel progressive disclosure
entries.text: 屬性面板 SHALL 採用漸進式揭露設計——平時隱藏，僅在使用者選中節點時顯示。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Properties panel progressive disclosure > Scenario: 選中節點顯示屬性面板
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊選中一個節點
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 在畫布側邊顯示屬性面板，包含顏色選擇、字體大小、內容編輯

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Editor > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Properties panel progressive disclosure > Scenario: 取消選中隱藏屬性面板
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊畫布空白處
- **THEN** 屬性面板 SHALL 自動隱藏

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > Purpose
entries.text: Enable interoperability between textual Mermaid flowchart syntax and visual Knowledge Graph documents, allowing users to leverage AI-generated diagrams or migrate existing diagrams.

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 支援將 Mermaid flowchart 語法的受控子集解析為 GraphDocument 的 nodes 和 edges。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import > Scenario: 匯入基本 flowchart
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者貼上合法的 Mermaid flowchart 語法（例如 `graph TD; A[Start] --> B[End]`）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 解析出對應的節點和連線，並在畫布上以自動佈局呈現

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import > Scenario: 支援方向宣告
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 語法包含 `graph TD`、`graph LR`、`flowchart TD` 或 `flowchart LR`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 正確解析方向宣告並據此決定自動佈局方向（上到下或左到右）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import > Scenario: 支援多種節點語法
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 語法包含 `A[text]`（方形）、`A(text)`（圓角）、`A{text}`（菱形）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 正確解析節點文字內容，節點形狀可透過 color 區分

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import > Scenario: 支援連線語法
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 語法包含 `A --> B`（單向箭頭）、`A --- B`（無箭頭）、`A -->|label| B`（帶標籤）、`A <--> B`（雙向箭頭）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 正確解析連線方向（對應 arrowType: arrow/none/both）、箭頭和標籤

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart import > Scenario: 支援 classDef 樣式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 語法包含 `classDef className fill:#color` 和 `class nodeId className`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 僅映射 `fill` 屬性為對應節點的 color 屬性（其餘 CSS 屬性如 stroke、font-size 等一律忽略）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline
entries.text: Mermaid 匯入 SHALL 在解析後、匯入前執行資料不變量驗證，確保匯入資料符合系統約束。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline > Scenario: 匯入時自連線過濾
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 語法包含自連線（如 `A --> A`）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 忽略該自連線，並在預覽結果中提示「已忽略 N 條自連線」

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline > Scenario: 匯入時標題長度截斷
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 節點文字超過 100 個字元
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 截斷至 100 個字元，並在預覽結果中提示「已截斷 N 個節點標題」

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline > Scenario: 匯入時連線標籤長度截斷
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 連線標籤超過 100 個字元
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 截斷至 100 個字元

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline > Scenario: 匯入時特殊字元正規化
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 節點文字包含 HTML entities 或轉義字元
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 解碼為純文字後存入 GraphNode.data.title

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import validation pipeline > Scenario: 匯入驗證管線順序
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 匯入動作觸發
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 依序執行：1. 解析語法 → 2. 正規化形狀/箭頭 → 3. 過濾自連線 → 4. 截斷超長文字 → 5. 產生預覽 → 6. 使用者確認後寫入

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import error handling
entries.text: Mermaid 匯入 SHALL 提供清楚的錯誤處理和使用者回饋。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import error handling > Scenario: 不支援的語法
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者貼上包含 subgraph、click 事件或非 flowchart 圖表類型的 Mermaid 語法
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示明確的錯誤訊息，說明哪些語法不被支援

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import error handling > Scenario: 語法解析失敗
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者貼上語法錯誤的 Mermaid 程式碼
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示解析錯誤位置和修正建議

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import error handling > Scenario: 匯入預覽
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在匯入對話框中貼上 Mermaid 語法
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 先顯示解析結果預覽（節點數量、連線數量），讓使用者確認後再匯入

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import error handling > Scenario: 匯入至新文件或現有文件
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者確認匯入
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 提供選項：建立新圖表文件，或追加至現有圖表

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 支援將 GraphDocument 的 nodes 和 edges 匯出為 Mermaid flowchart 語法。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 基本匯出
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊「匯出 Mermaid」按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 生成合法的 Mermaid flowchart 語法，包含所有節點和連線

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 匯出包含標籤
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 圖表中的連線帶有標籤
- **THEN** 匯出的 Mermaid 語法 SHALL 使用 `-->|label|` 格式包含連線標籤

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 匯出雙向箭頭
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 圖表中的連線 arrowType 為 'both'
- **THEN** 匯出的 Mermaid 語法 SHALL 使用 `<-->` 格式（帶標籤時為 `<-->|label|`）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 匯出結果可複製
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 匯出結果顯示在對話框中
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 提供「複製到剪貼簿」按鈕，支援一鍵複製

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: Mermaid 特殊字元 escape
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 節點標題包含 Mermaid 保留字元（`[`, `]`, `(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `>`, `|`, `;`）
- **THEN** 匯出的 Mermaid 語法 SHALL 對這些字元進行嚴格 escape（使用 `"text"` 語法或替換），確保匯出結果為合法 Mermaid

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 匯入文字長度限制
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者貼上超過 5000 個字元的 Mermaid 語法
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示錯誤提示，拒絕解析過長輸入

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid flowchart export > Scenario: 匯出的 Mermaid 可重新匯入
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者將匯出的 Mermaid 語法重新匯入
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 正確還原所有節點和連線（座標位置可能因自動佈局而不同）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import modal UI
entries.text: Mermaid 匯入 SHALL 透過專屬 Modal 對話框進行，提供清晰的操作引導。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import modal UI > Scenario: 開啟匯入對話框
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊工具列的「匯入 Mermaid」按鈕
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示包含文字輸入區域的 Modal，並提供語法提示和範例

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import modal UI > Scenario: Mermaid 匯入遇圖表上限
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者選擇「建立新圖表」但已達 20 份上限
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 阻止新建，顯示錯誤訊息建議刪除舊圖表或選擇追加至現有圖表

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Mermaid Bridge > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mermaid import modal UI > Scenario: 自動佈局
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Mermaid 匯入完成
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 使用知識圖既有的 radial 佈局演算法排列節點位置，避免引入額外第三方佈局依賴

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > Purpose
entries.text: Optimize the consumption of knowledge diagrams on various devices and learning contexts by providing different ways to visualize and explore node content.

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode toggle
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 提供兩種閱讀模式：「全部展開」和「逐步探索」，作為頁面層級狀態（非全域設定、非使用者偏好）。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode toggle > Scenario: 切換至全部展開模式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊閱讀模式切換按鈕選擇「全部展開」
- **THEN** 所有節點 SHALL 同時顯示完整內容（Level 1 標題 + Level 2 定義 + Level 3 補充）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode toggle > Scenario: 切換至逐步探索模式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊閱讀模式切換按鈕選擇「逐步探索」
- **THEN** 所有節點 SHALL 僅顯示 Level 1 標題，Level 2 和 Level 3 內容收合隱藏

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode toggle > Scenario: 預設閱讀模式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者首次進入知識圖工作區
- **THEN** 閱讀模式 SHALL 預設為「逐步探索」

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Progressive content disclosure
entries.text: 在「逐步探索」模式下，節點內容 SHALL 支援逐層展開，遵循三層資訊架構。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Progressive content disclosure > Scenario: 點擊展開 Level 2
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在逐步探索模式下點擊一個僅顯示標題的節點
- **THEN** 該節點 SHALL 展開顯示 Level 2 定義內容（若存在）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Progressive content disclosure > Scenario: 再次點擊展開 Level 3
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在逐步探索模式下點擊一個已展開 Level 2 的節點
- **THEN** 該節點 SHALL 進一步展開顯示 Level 3 補充說明（若存在）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Progressive content disclosure > Scenario: 收合節點
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在逐步探索模式下再次點擊一個已完全展開的節點
- **THEN** 該節點 SHALL 收合回僅顯示 Level 1 標題

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Progressive content disclosure > Scenario: 節點無更多層級
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者點擊一個沒有 Level 2 / Level 3 內容的節點
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 不做任何展開動作（無視覺跳動）

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode persists per document
entries.text: 閱讀模式 SHALL 作為 GraphDocument 的 viewState 的一部分儲存，每份文件獨立記憶。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode persists per document > Scenario: 閱讀模式隨文件儲存
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者切換閱讀模式後離開工作區
- **THEN** 下次回到同一份圖表時 SHALL 恢復上次的閱讀模式設定

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode persists per document > Scenario: 不同文件獨立模式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者將文件 A 設為全部展開、文件 B 設為逐步探索
- **THEN** 切換文件時 SHALL 各自恢復對應的閱讀模式

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode available on all devices
entries.text: 閱讀模式切換 SHALL 在桌面端和手機端均可使用。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Reading mode available on all devices > Scenario: 手機端閱讀模式
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者在手機端（螢幕寬度 ≤ 768px）瀏覽知識圖
- **THEN** 閱讀模式切換按鈕 SHALL 可見且可操作

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Expand-all shows complete node information
entries.text: 在「全部展開」模式下，所有節點 SHALL 自動調整大小以容納完整內容。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Expand-all shows complete node information > Scenario: 節點自動調整大小
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 閱讀模式切換為「全部展開」
- **THEN** 每個節點的高度 SHALL 自動擴展以完整顯示所有層級的文字內容，不出現截斷或滾動條

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge labels in reading mode
entries.text: 連線標籤 SHALL 在所有閱讀模式下保持可見。

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge labels in reading mode > Scenario: 全部展開模式中的連線標籤
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 閱讀模式為「全部展開」
- **THEN** 所有連線標籤 SHALL 完整顯示

entries.heading: Spec: Knowledge Graph Reading Modes > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Edge labels in reading mode > Scenario: 逐步探索模式中的連線標籤
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 閱讀模式為「逐步探索」
- **THEN** 所有連線標籤 SHALL 完整顯示（不隨節點展開狀態變化）

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Configurable AI Provider
entries.text: The system MUST allow users to switch between Google (default) and NVIDIA/OpenAI-compatible providers.

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Configurable AI Provider > Scenario: User configures NVIDIA API
entries.text:
- **Given** the user opens the Settings modal
- **When** they select "NVIDIA" as the AI Provider
- **Then** the "Base URL" field should appear (defaulting to `https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1`)
- **And** the Model selector should allow entering a custom model ID (or select from presets like `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.2`)

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA/OpenAI Integration
entries.text: The system MUST be able to dispatch AI requests using the OpenAI Chat Completion protocol when the NVIDIA provider is selected. In production environments without a proxy, the system MUST fail with a clear, actionable error message instead of silently failing.

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA/OpenAI Integration > Scenario: AI Request with NVIDIA
entries.text:
- **Given** the user has configured NVIDIA API
- **When** they click "AI Helper" in a quiz
- **Then** the application should send the request to the configured Base URL using the OpenAI Chat Completion format
- **And** the `Authorization` header should contain `Bearer <NVIDIA_KEY>`

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA/OpenAI Integration > Scenario: Custom Model Support
entries.text:
- **Given** the NVIDIA provider is selected
- **When** the user types a custom model name (e.g., `meta/llama-3-70b`)
- **Then** the API request should use that specific model string

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA base URL supports production proxy
entries.text: `resolveNvidiaBaseUrl()` SHALL 在生產環境中允許使用同源 Vercel proxy 路徑（`/api/nvidia`），而非強制拋出錯誤阻止請求。

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA base URL supports production proxy > Scenario: Production with no custom baseUrl
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 應用在生產環境執行
- **AND** 用戶未設定自訂 `baseUrl`（或 `baseUrl` 為預設 NVIDIA URL）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回傳 `${origin}/api/nvidia` 作為請求端點
- **AND** 系統 SHALL NOT 拋出 Error

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA base URL supports production proxy > Scenario: Production with custom baseUrl
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 應用在生產環境執行
- **AND** 用戶已設定自訂 `baseUrl`（非預設值）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回傳用戶設定的 `baseUrl`

entries.heading: Spec: NVIDIA API Support > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: NVIDIA base URL supports production proxy > Scenario: Development with no custom baseUrl
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 應用在開發環境執行
- **AND** 用戶未設定自訂 `baseUrl`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回傳 `${origin}/api/nvidia` 作為請求端點

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Purpose
entries.text: 定義練習進度（Practice Session）在 localStorage 及 Supabase 中的存儲規格、安全 RLS 及登入同步與衝突解決策略。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Supabase practice_sessions table
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 在 Supabase 中建立 `practice_sessions` 表，用於跨設備同步分階段練習進度。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Supabase practice_sessions table > Scenario: Table creation via migration
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 管理員執行 migration SQL
- **THEN** `practice_sessions` 表 SHALL 包含以下欄位：
  - `id` (UUID, PK, auto-generated)
  - `user_id` (UUID, FK → auth.users, NOT NULL, ON DELETE CASCADE)
  - `bank_ids` (UUID[], NOT NULL) — 支援多題庫
  - `bank_names` (TEXT[], NOT NULL)
  - `bank_question_map` (JSONB, NOT NULL) — `{ [bankId]: string[] }` 題庫→題目快照對照
  - `chunk_size` (INTEGER, NOT NULL)
  - `question_ids` (TEXT[], NOT NULL) — 所有題目 ID 的有序快照
  - `chunks` (JSONB, NOT NULL) — PracticeChunk[] 序列化
  - `status` (TEXT, NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('active', 'completed', 'abandoned'), DEFAULT 'active')
  - `created_at` (TIMESTAMPTZ, DEFAULT NOW())
  - `updated_at` (TIMESTAMPTZ, DEFAULT NOW()) — SHALL 在 row UPDATE 時自動推進（例如 trigger）
- **THEN** 表 SHALL 有 `idx_practice_sessions_user_status` 索引（`user_id, status`）
- **THEN** 表 SHALL 有複合索引 `idx_practice_sessions_user_status_updated_at`（`user_id, status, updated_at DESC`）以支援 Dashboard 依 `updated_at` 排序

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security for practice_sessions
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 對 `practice_sessions` 表實施 RLS 政策，確保使用者只能存取自己的資料。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security for practice_sessions > Scenario: User reads own sessions
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已認證的使用者查詢 `practice_sessions`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 僅返回 `user_id` 等於當前使用者 ID 的 rows

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security for practice_sessions > Scenario: User cannot read other user's sessions
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者 A 嘗試查詢使用者 B 的 practice sessions
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 返回空結果集
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL NOT 拋出錯誤

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security for practice_sessions > Scenario: User writes own session
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已認證的使用者插入或更新 practice_sessions
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 僅允許 `user_id = auth.uid()` 的操作

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: IStorageRepository practice session extension
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 擴展 `IStorageRepository` 介面，新增以下方法用於 practice session 管理。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: IStorageRepository practice session extension > Scenario: Interface methods
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 開發者實作 `IStorageRepository`
- **THEN** 介面 SHALL 包含以下方法：
  - `getPracticeSessions(): Promise<ChunkedPracticeSession[]>` — 取得所有 active sessions
  - `savePracticeSession(session: ChunkedPracticeSession): Promise<void>` — 新增或更新 session
  - `deletePracticeSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void>` — 刪除 session
  - `abandonPracticeSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void>` — 標記為 abandoned

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: LocalStorageRepository practice session implementation
entries.text: `LocalStorageRepository` SHALL 在 `localStorage` key `mindspark_practice_sessions` 下存儲 practice sessions。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: LocalStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Save and retrieve in guest mode
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Guest 使用者創建一個 practice session
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將 session 序列化為 JSON 存入 `mindspark_practice_sessions`
- **THEN** 再次讀取時 SHALL 返回相同的 session 資料

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: LocalStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Guest mode FIFO limit
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Guest 使用者已有 5 個 active sessions，再創建第 6 個
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 自動將最舊的 session 標記為 `abandoned`
- **THEN** 新 session SHALL 被正常創建
- **THEN** active sessions 總數 SHALL NOT 超過 5

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: LocalStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Guest mode total retention limit
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Guest 模式下 localStorage 中的 sessions 總數（含 `active` / `abandoned` / `completed`）超過 10
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 從最舊的非 active sessions（`abandoned` / `completed`）開始「物理刪除」直到總數 ≤ 10
- **THEN** active sessions（`status = 'active'`）總數 SHALL 仍維持 ≤ 5

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: CloudStorageRepository practice session implementation
entries.text: `CloudStorageRepository` SHALL 通過 Supabase API 操作 `practice_sessions` 表。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: CloudStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Cloud save on chunk completion
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已登入使用者完成一個 Chunk
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 使用 upsert（`onConflict: 'id'`）寫入 Supabase
- **THEN** `updated_at` SHALL 更新為當前時間戳

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: CloudStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Cloud read on dashboard load
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已登入使用者開啟 Dashboard
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 從 Supabase 查詢所有 `status = 'active'` 的 sessions
- **THEN** sessions SHALL 按 `updated_at` 降序排列

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: CloudStorageRepository practice session implementation > Scenario: Cloud save failure graceful handling
entries.text:
- **WHEN** Supabase upsert 失敗（網路問題）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將 session 暫存於 localStorage 作為 fallback
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 顯示 toast 警告「雲端同步失敗，進度已暫存在本地」
- **THEN** 下次 Dashboard 載入時 SHALL 嘗試重新同步

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 在使用者登入時，將 localStorage 中的 practice sessions 同步到雲端。當雲端 session 較新時，系統 SHALL 將雲端版本回寫到本機 localStorage。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Sync local sessions to cloud on login
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 之前以 Guest 模式創建了 2 個 active practice sessions，然後登入
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 先讀取雲端 `status = 'active'` sessions，作為合併基準
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 逐筆比較 local 與 cloud 中相同 `id` 的 `updated_at`，並採用 Last-Write-Wins（保留較新的那份）
  - 若 local 較新 → SHALL upsert 到雲端
  - 若 cloud 較新或相同 → SHALL NOT 以 local 覆蓋雲端
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將「需要上傳且 upsert 成功」或「被判定為較舊」的 local 副本自 localStorage 移除
- **THEN** 若 upsert 失敗 → local 副本 SHALL 保留作為 fallback（並標記為待重試），下次登入或 Dashboard 載入時再嘗試同步

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Cloud-newer sessions are written back to local
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 本機 session A 的 `updatedAt` 為 `1000`
- **AND** 雲端 session A 的 `updatedAt` 為 `2000`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將雲端版本的 session A 加入 `updatedLocalSessions`
- **AND** 雲端 session A SHALL 被回寫到本機 localStorage
- **AND** 本機版本 SHALL 被取代為雲端版本
- **AND** `skipped` 計數器 SHALL 遞增
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 清理該 session 的 chunk drafts 以避免狀態不一致

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Cloud-only sessions are preserved during sync
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 雲端存在 session B，但本機不存在對應 session
- **THEN** session B SHALL NOT 被刪除或覆蓋
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 不主動拉取雲端 only 的 session 到本機（此為同步方向：本機→雲端）

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Local-only sessions are uploaded
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 本機存在 session C，但雲端不存在對應 session
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將 session C upsert 到雲端
- **AND** `uploaded` 計數器 SHALL 遞增

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Active session limit is enforced on writeback
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 回寫雲端版本造成本機 active sessions 超過上限
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 依既定策略裁切（例如保留最新 N 筆）
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 記錄被裁切的 sessionId 以便追蹤

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: Login triggers practice session sync > Scenario: Clock drift guard for LWW
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 本機與雲端 `updatedAt` 差距超過合理閾值
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 採保守策略（偏向雲端或要求重試）
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 記錄警告以便診斷

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: STORAGE_KEYS registry update
entries.text: `services/storage.ts` 的 `STORAGE_KEYS` 物件 SHALL 新增 `PRACTICE_SESSIONS: 'mindspark_practice_sessions'` 條目。

entries.heading: 核心規格 - 練習進度存儲 (Practice Session Storage) > Requirements > Requirement: STORAGE_KEYS registry update > Scenario: Storage key registration
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 程式碼引用 practice sessions 的 localStorage key
- **THEN** SHALL 使用 `STORAGE_KEYS.PRACTICE_SESSIONS` 常數
- **THEN** SHALL NOT 使用 hardcoded 字串

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Overview
entries.text: 遊戲級技能特效渲染引擎，負責小技能 (5/10/15/20/25 連擊) 的視覺效果。

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Requirements > REQ-1: 多層粒子動畫
entries.text:
- 技能觸發時產生 8-16 個粒子向外擴散 (Legendary 級別上限 30)
- 粒子顏色根據技能元素 (火/冰/雷/虛空/神聖/宇宙) 變化
- 粒子帶有動態模糊殘影/拖尾效果

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Requirements > REQ-2: 漸層光環效果
entries.text:
- 中心光環從 0% 擴展至 200% 後消失
- 光環使用 blur + gradient 實現柔和效果

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Requirements > REQ-3: 螢幕震動
entries.text:
- 高級技能 (advanced+) 觸發時添加螢幕震動
- 震動持續時間: 300ms (優化後)

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Requirements > REQ-4: 技能名稱動態顯示
entries.text:
- 技能名稱從底部滑入，帶漸層背景
- 顯示 2 秒後淡出

entries.heading: Skill Effects Engine Spec > Acceptance Criteria
entries.text:
- [x] 5 連擊觸發基礎技能，顯示粒子和光環
- [x] 20 連擊觸發高級技能，添加螢幕震動
- [x] 動畫使用 GPU 加速 (transform)，FPS 穩定 60

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > Purpose
entries.text: Decouple UI components from data access logic for social and sharing features, improving maintainability and testability.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Social Operations in Service Layer
entries.text: All Supabase queries related to friendships, sharing, and social features MUST be encapsulated in `services/socialService.ts`. UI components SHALL NOT directly import or use the `supabase` client for social operations.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Social Operations in Service Layer > Scenario: Social.tsx uses service layer
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `Social.tsx` needs to fetch friends list
- **THEN** it SHALL call `getFriendsAndInbox()` from `services/socialService.ts`
- **AND** it SHALL NOT contain any `supabase.from(...)` calls

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Social Operations in Service Layer > Scenario: ShareModal.tsx uses service layer
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `ShareModal.tsx` needs to share a bank
- **THEN** it SHALL call `shareBank()` from `services/socialService.ts`
- **AND** it SHALL NOT contain any `supabase.from(...)` calls

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Friendship Delete RLS Policy
entries.text: The `friendships` table in Supabase MUST have a DELETE policy allowing either party of a friendship to delete the record.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Friendship Delete RLS Policy > Scenario: User deletes a friendship
entries.text:
- **WHEN** User A calls `supabase.from('friendships').delete().eq('id', friendshipId)`
- **AND** User A is either `user_id` or `friend_id` of that friendship
- **THEN** the deletion SHALL succeed (not blocked by RLS)

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Only the invited party can accept a friend request
entries.text: `acceptFriendRequest()` SHALL 限制僅有被邀請方（`friend_id` 等於當前用戶 ID）可以接受好友請求，發起方不得自我核准。

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Only the invited party can accept a friend request > Scenario: Invited user accepts request
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 被邀請方（`friend_id` === 當前用戶 ID）呼叫 `acceptFriendRequest(friendshipId)`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 將 friendship 狀態更新為 `accepted`
- **AND** Supabase 更新查詢 SHALL 使用 `.eq('id', friendshipId).eq('friend_id', userId)` 而非 `.or(...)`

entries.heading: Spec: Social Service Layer > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Only the invited party can accept a friend request > Scenario: Initiator attempts self-acceptance
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 邀請發起方（`user_id` === 當前用戶 ID 且 `friend_id` !== 當前用戶 ID）呼叫 `acceptFriendRequest(friendshipId)`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL NOT 更新任何記錄（Supabase query 不匹配 any 行）
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 不拋出錯誤（靜默失敗，因為 Supabase 的 `.eq` 不匹配只是返回空結果）

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Friend Management
entries.text: Users MUST be able to add other users as friends to facilitate sharing.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Friend Management > Scenario: Sending Friend Request
entries.text: User A enters User B's email. User B appears in "Pending". Once User B accepts, they become "Friends".

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Direct Bank Sharing
entries.text: Users SHALL be able to send a copy of a Question Bank to a friend.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Direct Bank Sharing > Scenario: Sharing a Bank
entries.text: User A clicks "Share" on "Math 101". Selects User B. User B receives a notification.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Bank Acceptance
entries.text: Users MUST explicitly accept shared content before it is added to their library. Upon acceptance, the system SHALL create entirely new question records with freshly generated UUIDs to avoid RLS policy conflicts with the sender's original data.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Bank Acceptance > Scenario: Accepting a Shared Bank
entries.text:
- **WHEN** User B sees "Math 101 from User A" in their Inbox
- **AND** User B clicks "Accept"
- **THEN** the system SHALL create a new bank owned by User B
- **AND** the system SHALL generate a new UUID via a `generateUUID()` helper function (with fallback for non-HTTPS environments) for each question in the shared bank snapshot
- **AND** the system SHALL save all questions with the new UUIDs to User B's bank
- **AND** the bank SHALL persist with the correct question count after User B navigates away and returns
- **AND** no 403 Forbidden errors SHALL occur during the save operation

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Bank Acceptance > Scenario: Shared bank data integrity after navigation
entries.text:
- **WHEN** User B has accepted a shared bank
- **AND** User B navigates away from the social page to the Dashboard
- **AND** User B returns to the Dashboard
- **THEN** the accepted bank SHALL display the correct number of questions (matching the original shared bank)
- **AND** the questions SHALL be fully accessible for quizzes

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge Zero Score Completion
entries.text: The challenge system MUST correctly handle the case where a participant scores 0 points. A score of 0 MUST be treated as a valid submitted score, not as "not yet submitted".

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge Zero Score Completion > Scenario: Opponent scores 0
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the challenger submits their score
- **AND** the opponent's score is 0 (not null)
- **THEN** the challenge SHALL be marked as `completed`
- **AND** the winner SHALL be determined by comparing the scores

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge Zero Score Completion > Scenario: Opponent has not submitted
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the challenger submits their score
- **AND** the opponent's score is `null`
- **THEN** the challenge SHALL remain `active` (not completed)

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > MODIFIED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge Data Fetching (Modified)
entries.text: The `getMyChallenges()` function MUST fetch challenge data and related profile/bank information without causing PostgREST 400 errors.

entries.heading: Spec: Social Sharing > MODIFIED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge Data Fetching (Modified) > Scenario: Fetching challenges with joined profile data
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the app calls `getMyChallenges()`
- **THEN** the Supabase query fetches raw challenges
- **AND** the app manually queries and joins related `profiles` and `bank` data
- **AND** the response status is `200 OK` (not `400 Bad Request`)

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > Purpose
entries.text: Centralize localStorage key management and ensure app stability by preventing stale data and cleanup legacy artifacts.

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Centralized Storage Keys
entries.text: All localStorage key strings MUST be defined in a single registry (e.g., `STORAGE_KEYS` in `services/storage.ts`). Hardcoded `mindspark_*` strings in hooks, contexts, and services MUST be replaced with references to this registry.

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Centralized Storage Keys > Scenario: No hardcoded localStorage keys
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a developer searches for `'mindspark_` in hooks, contexts, and services
- **THEN** no hardcoded key strings SHALL be found
- **AND** all keys (including `mindspark_graphs` for knowledge diagrams) SHALL reference `STORAGE_KEYS.<name>` from the central registry
- **AND** the Beta feature flags SHALL be integrated within the `mindspark_settings` key

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Legacy File Cleanup
entries.text: The following files/directories MUST be removed: `src/services/supabase.ts`, `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` (if unused), and the `nul` file in the project root.

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Legacy File Cleanup > Scenario: No legacy src files
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a developer checks the `src/` directory
- **THEN** `src/services/supabase.ts` SHALL NOT exist
- **AND** `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` SHALL NOT exist (unless actively imported)
- **AND** the root-level `nul` file SHALL NOT exist

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Stale Response Prevention
entries.text: The `loadQuizPool` function in `useAppDataLoader` MUST discard results from outdated requests using a version counter or AbortController pattern.

entries.heading: Spec: Storage Key Registry > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Stale Response Prevention > Scenario: Rapid bank selection changes
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user rapidly changes bank selection 3 times (A → B → C)
- **THEN** only the response for selection C SHALL be applied to state
- **AND** responses from selections A and B SHALL be discarded if they arrive after C

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > Purpose
entries.text: Ensure the security and integrity of user data stored in Supabase by enforcing Row Level Security (RLS) and securing database functions and authentication.

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security on Public Tables
entries.text: The system MUST enforce Row Level Security (RLS) on the following tables: `study_sessions`, `user_study_stats_30day`, `user_streaks`, `user_achievements`, and `challenges`. It SHALL restrict access to those rows where the user identifier matches the authenticated session's UID.

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security on Public Tables > Scenario: Unauthorized Access Blocked
entries.text:
- **WHEN** an unauthenticated client or an authenticated client with a `uid` different from the row's owner attempts to SELECT or UPDATE the `study_sessions` table
- **THEN** the Database MUST return an empty result set (for SELECT) or throw an error/deny the operation (for UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT)
- **AND** the database linter SHALL NOT report the table as having RLS disabled

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Row Level Security on Public Tables > Scenario: Authorized Access Allowed
entries.text:
- **WHEN** an authenticated user queries their own `user_study_stats_30day` where `user_id` equals `auth.uid()`
- **THEN** the Database MUST return the correct rows or allow modification

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Secure Function Search Path
entries.text: The function `public.handle_new_user` MUST be configured with a defined `search_path` to prevent privilege escalation via schema manipulation.

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Secure Function Search Path > Scenario: Function Invocation is Path-Secure
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `handle_new_user` is triggered upon user registration
- **THEN** it MUST execute using the strict namespace provided by the configuration (e.g., `public`), disregarding the caller's mutable search path
- **AND** the database linter SHALL NOT report the function as having a mutable search path

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Leaked Password Protection in Auth
entries.text: The Supabase authentication service MUST be configured to refuse passwords identified in leaked password databases.

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Leaked Password Protection in Auth > Scenario: Vulnerable Password Usage Denied
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user attempts to sign up or change their password using a known compromised password (e.g. found on HaveIBeenPwned)
- **THEN** the Supabase Auth system MUST reject the request
- **AND** the Frontend SHOULD display an error instructing the user to pick a more secure password
- **AND** the database linter SHALL NOT report leaked password protection as disabled

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank queries MUST filter by authenticated user
entries.text: `getCloudBanks()` SHALL 在查詢 `banks` 表時強制附加 `.eq('user_id', user.id)` 過濾條件，確保只回傳屬於當前登入用戶的題庫。

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank queries MUST filter by authenticated user > Scenario: Authenticated user fetches banks
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已登入用戶呼叫 `getCloudBanks()`
- **THEN** Supabase 查詢 SHALL 包含 `.eq('user_id', user.id)` 條件
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 先呼叫 `supabase.auth.getUser()` 取得用戶 ID
- **AND** 若用戶未登入，系統 SHALL 回傳空陣列 `[]`

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank queries MUST filter by authenticated user > Scenario: Unauthenticated user fetches banks
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 未登入用戶呼叫 `getCloudBanks()`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 回傳空陣列 `[]` 而不發送 any Supabase 查詢

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank deletion MUST verify ownership
entries.text: `deleteCloudBank()` SHALL 在刪除 `banks` 表的記錄時附加 `.eq('user_id', user.id)` 過濾條件，確保只能刪除屬於自己的題庫。

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank deletion MUST verify ownership > Scenario: Authenticated user deletes own bank
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 已登入用戶呼叫 `deleteCloudBank(bankId)`
- **THEN** Supabase 刪除查詢 SHALL 同時包含 `.eq('id', bankId)` 與 `.eq('user_id', user.id)` 條件
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 先呼叫 `supabase.auth.getUser()` 取得用戶 ID

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Cloud bank deletion MUST verify ownership > Scenario: Unauthenticated user attempts deletion
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 未登入用戶呼叫 `deleteCloudBank(bankId)`
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 不執行 any 刪除操作
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 記錄警告日誌

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge score determination via server-side RPC
entries.text:
聯賽分數提交 SHALL 強制使用 Supabase RPC 函數 `submit_challenge_score(p_challenge_id, p_score)` 來提交分數並由後端判定勝負。不允許 any 前端 fallback 判定，以防止繞過安全機制。
- **後端安全要求**：
  - **IDOR 防禦**：RPC 必須驗證呼叫者身份（`auth.uid()`），僅允許該挑戰的參與者（`user_id` 或 `friend_id`）提交分數。
  - **數值校驗**：RPC 必須對提交的 `p_score` 進行合理上限校驗（例如限制在題庫總分的合理範圍內，或 p_score >= 0），防止送出惡意偽造高分。

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge score determination via server-side RPC > Scenario: RPC available - submit score
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 用戶提交聯賽分數
- **AND** Supabase RPC `submit_challenge_score` 可用
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 呼叫 RPC 函數傳入 `challenge_id` 和 `score`
- **AND** 系統 SHALL NOT 在前端計算 `winner_id`
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 依據 RPC 回傳結果更新 UI

entries.heading: Spec: Supabase Security Hardening > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Challenge score determination via server-side RPC > Scenario: RPC failure - fail-fast
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 用戶提交聯賽分數
- **AND** Supabase RPC 呼叫失敗（函數不存在或網路錯誤）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 拋出明確錯誤並中斷提交操作
- **AND** 系統 SHALL NOT 回退至前端判定邏輯
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 提示用戶提交失敗且不寫入 any 本地或雲端的 winner 判定

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Purpose
entries.text: TBD - created by archiving change security-and-sync-hardening. Update Purpose after archive.

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 在 `syncLocalPracticeSessions` 與 `syncLocalToCloud` 執行期間透過跨分頁安全鎖阻止並發調用。鎖的實作 SHALL 採 `navigator.locks` Web Locks API 為主（跨瀏覽器分頁共享、瀏覽器管理生命週期），並在 `navigator.locks` 不可用時降級為 timestamped localStorage lock（鎖鍵 `mindspark_sync_lock_ts`，30 秒過期防死鎖）。舊版 `window.__MINDSPARK_SYNC_LOCK__` 記憶體鎖 SHALL 被移除。`isSyncingPracticeSessions` 模組級旗標得以保留作為同分頁內第二重防護。鎖 SHALL 在同步與寫入的整個 lifecycle 中被持有，無論成功或失敗皆 SHALL 在執行完畢後釋放。當鎖不可得時，第二次呼叫 SHALL 立即返回空結果或拋出互斥錯誤並記錄 `console.warn`。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution > Scenario: Duplicate sync call is rejected
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `syncLocalPracticeSessions` 或 `syncLocalToCloud` 正在執行中
- **AND** 另一個調用者（例如 React Effect 重跑、路由切換、另一個分頁）再次呼叫同步
- **THEN** 第二次呼叫 SHALL 被拒絕或返回 `EMPTY_SYNC_RESULT`
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 記錄 console.warn 說明跳過原因
- **AND** 第一次呼叫 SHALL 不受影響，繼續正常執行

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution > Scenario: Lock is released after sync completion
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 同步事務執行完畢（無論成功或失敗）
- **THEN** 鎖 SHALL 被釋放（Web Locks 的 callback resolve 或清除 localStorage 鎖鍵）
- **AND** 後續的 sync 呼叫 SHALL 能正常取得鎖並執行

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution > Scenario: Web Locks unavailable falls back to 30s timestamped localStorage lock
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `navigator.locks.request` 不可用（例如舊版瀏覽器）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 嘗試取得 timestamped localStorage lock（`mindspark_sync_lock_ts`）
- **AND** 若 localStorage 中現存鎖值與當前時間差距 < 30000ms SHALL 視為被持有，拒絕此次併發
- **AND** 若鎖值 >= 30000ms 或不存在 SHALL 視為可取得，寫入當前 timestamp 並繼續執行

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution > Scenario: Fallback lock self-clears after timeout
entries.text:
- **WHEN** fallback localStorage lock 被取得但同步在 30s 內未完成（例如瀏覽器凍結、OOM）
- **THEN** 後續呼叫在讀取鎖值時 SHALL 偵測到差距 >= 30000ms 並允許覆寫取得鎖
- **AND** SHALL 記錄 `console.warn` 報告已偵測到過期鎖

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync concurrency lock prevents duplicate sync execution > Scenario: Original memory lock is removed
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 讀取 `services/cloudStorage.ts`
- **THEN** 程式碼 SHALL NOT 包含 `window.__MINDSPARK_SYNC_LOCK__` 任何引用

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud limits concurrent bank uploads
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 對 `syncLocalToCloud` 的 bank 上傳加入並發上限，避免一次性觸發大量請求造成 Rate Limit。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud limits concurrent bank uploads > Scenario: Concurrency is capped
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者有 50 個 bank 需要同步
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 以固定並發上限分批處理（例如每批 3~5 個）
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 仍回傳完整的成功/失敗摘要

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud returns failure summary
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 回傳同步摘要（成功/失敗 bank IDs 與錯誤訊息），供 UI 呈現部分失敗與重試入口。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud returns failure summary > Scenario: Partial failure summary is returned
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 同步過程中有部分 bank 失敗
- **THEN** 回傳結果 SHALL 包含失敗 bank 的識別與錯誤訊息

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud uses Promise.allSettled for fault isolation
entries.text: 系統 SHALL 在 `syncLocalToCloud` 中使用 `Promise.allSettled` 替代 `Promise.all`，以確保單一 bank 的同步失敗不會中斷其他 bank 的同步。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud uses Promise.allSettled for fault isolation > Scenario: One bank fails while others succeed
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 使用者有 3 個本機 bank 需要同步
- **AND** 第 2 個 bank 的 `createCloudBank` 失敗（例如網路超時）
- **THEN** 第 1 個和第 3 個 bank 的同步 SHALL 正常完成
- **AND** 系統 SHALL 記錄第 2 個 bank 的失敗原因至 console.error
- **AND** 函式 SHALL NOT 拋出 unhandled rejection

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud uses Promise.allSettled for fault isolation > Scenario: All banks fail
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 所有 bank 的同步都失敗（例如 Supabase 完全不可用）
- **THEN** 系統 SHALL 記錄所有失敗原因
- **AND** 函式 SHALL 正常返回（不拋錯）
- **AND** 本機資料 SHALL 不受影響

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: syncLocalToCloud uses Promise.allSettled for fault isolation > Scenario: All banks succeed
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 所有 bank 的同步都成功
- **THEN** 行為 SHALL 與使用 `Promise.all` 時完全一致

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync lock uses typed Window interface extension
entries.text: 若 NavigatorLocks 在專案 TypeScript lib.dom.d.ts 中型別不完整，`types/global.d.ts` SHALL 補充 `NavigatorLocks` 介面擴充以避免 `as any`。`navigator.locks.request` 的存取 SHALL 通過 TypeScript 編譯不需 `as any`。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync lock uses typed Window interface extension > Scenario: Sync lock access with typed interface
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `syncLocalPracticeSessions` 讀寫 `navigator.locks.request`
- **THEN** 存取 SHALL 通過 `navigator.locks.request`（無需 `as any` 轉型）
- **AND** TypeScript 編譯 SHALL 通過 `npx tsc --noEmit` 無型別錯誤

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Sync lock uses typed Window interface extension > Scenario: global.d.ts declares fallback lock types as needed
entries.text:
- **WHEN** TypeScript 編譯器處理 `cloudStorage.ts`
- **THEN** 若 lib.dom.d.ts 的 `NavigatorLocks` 型別不完整，`types/global.d.ts` SHALL 包含補充宣告
- **AND** 專案中 SHALL 不存在 any `as any` 表達式用於 sync lock 存取

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Cross-tab sync lock via Web Locks API
entries.text: `syncLocalPracticeSessions` 與 `syncLocalToCloud` SHALL 透過 `navigator.locks.request(SYNC_LOCK_NAME, { mode: 'exclusive' }, callback)` 取得跨分頁排他鎖。`SYNC_LOCK_NAME` 為模組常數 `'mindspark_practice_sync'`。Callback SHALL 傳入非同步邏輯，且鎖的持有期 SHALL 完整包覆 Supabase 雲端請求與本地寫入，直至 Promise resolve。

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Cross-tab sync lock via Web Locks API > Scenario: Web Locks acquired successfully
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `navigator.locks.request` 可用且鎖為空閒
- **THEN** Web Locks API SHALL 執行 callback
- **AND** 同步邏輯 (包含網路與本地 I/O) SHALL 在 callback 內執行
- **AND** Promise resolve 後鎖 SHALL 自動釋放

entries.heading: sync-concurrency-control Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Cross-tab sync lock via Web Locks API > Scenario: BANKS_META updates protected by lock
entries.text:
- **WHEN** `syncLocalToCloud` 觸發
- **THEN** 其讀取與更新本地 `BANKS_META` (寫入 `cloudSyncedAt`) 的全部非同步操作 SHALL 完整在 `runWithSyncLock` 封裝中被執行
- **AND** 多個分頁同時登入時，對 `BANKS_META` 的讀寫會依序序列化執行，無法並發 Race。

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > Purpose
entries.text: Ensure a robust and reliable testing environment by separating units tests from E2E tests and unifying configuration.

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Vitest Must Exclude E2E Tests
entries.text: Vitest SHALL only execute unit tests located in `src/__tests__/`. E2E tests in `e2e/` MUST NOT be picked up by Vitest's test runner.

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Vitest Must Exclude E2E Tests > Scenario: Running npm test excludes E2E
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a developer runs `npm test`
- **THEN** Vitest SHALL only execute files matching `src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts?(x)`
- **AND** files in `e2e/`, `playwright-report/`, and `test-results/` SHALL be excluded
- **AND** the test run SHALL complete without Playwright-related errors

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Separate Test Scripts
entries.text: The project MUST provide separate npm scripts for unit tests and E2E tests.

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Separate Test Scripts > Scenario: Script separation
entries.text:
- **WHEN** developer runs `npm run test:unit`
- **THEN** Vitest SHALL execute unit tests only
- **WHEN** developer runs `npm run test:e2e`
- **THEN** Playwright SHALL execute E2E tests only

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Single Test Configuration Source
entries.text: Test configuration MUST exist in a single file (`vitest.config.ts`). The `test` block in `vite.config.ts` MUST be removed to prevent confusion.

entries.heading: Spec: Test Infrastructure > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Single Test Configuration Source > Scenario: No duplicate test config
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a developer inspects `vite.config.ts`
- **THEN** there SHALL be no `test` property in the config object
- **AND** all test configuration SHALL reside in `vitest.config.ts`

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dashboard Bank Action Buttons Visibility on Touch Devices
entries.text: The Dashboard bank card action buttons (直接開始, 分享, 移動) SHALL be visible and accessible on all touch devices without requiring a mouse hover interaction.

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dashboard Bank Action Buttons Visibility on Touch Devices > Scenario: Tablet user views bank cards
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user opens the Dashboard on a tablet device (e.g., iPad)
- **AND** the screen width is below the `md` breakpoint or the device has no precise pointer
- **THEN** the action buttons (直接開始, 分享, 移動) SHALL be visible at all times without requiring hover
- **AND** the buttons SHALL be tappable and functional

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dashboard Bank Action Buttons Visibility on Touch Devices > Scenario: Desktop user with mouse views bank cards
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user opens the Dashboard on a desktop with a mouse
- **AND** the screen width is at or above the `md` breakpoint
- **THEN** the action buttons SHALL be hidden by default
- **AND** the action buttons SHALL appear when the user hovers over the bank card

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dashboard Bank Action Buttons Visibility on Touch Devices > Scenario: Mobile user taps bank card
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user opens the Dashboard on a mobile phone
- **THEN** the action buttons SHALL be visible at all times
- **AND** the buttons SHALL be tappable and functional

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile Settings Access
entries.text: The system settings panel SHALL be accessible from mobile devices via the bottom navigation bar.

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile Settings Access > Scenario: Opening settings on mobile
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a user is on a mobile device (screen width below `md` breakpoint)
- **THEN** the bottom navigation bar SHALL display a "設定" (Settings) entry
- **AND** tapping the settings entry SHALL open the system settings panel

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Mobile Settings Access > Scenario: Settings icon on mobile nav bar
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the mobile bottom navigation bar is rendered
- **THEN** it SHALL display exactly 5 navigation items: 首頁, 管理, 設定, 社交, 指引
- **AND** the settings item SHALL use the Settings (gear) icon

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dark Mode QuizCard Option Readability
entries.text: Quiz card answer options SHALL maintain readable text contrast in dark mode, including during hover/selection states.

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dark Mode QuizCard Option Readability > Scenario: Hovering over unanswered option in dark mode
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the user is in dark mode
- **AND** the user hovers over an unanswered quiz option (Standard Mode)
- **THEN** the option background SHALL use a dark-compatible color (e.g., `dark:hover:bg-brand-900/20`)
- **AND** the text SHALL remain readable with sufficient contrast against the background

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: Dark Mode QuizCard Option Readability > Scenario: Selected multiple-choice option in dark mode
entries.text:
- **WHEN** the user is in dark mode
- **AND** selects an option in a multiple-choice question (before submitting)
- **THEN** the selected option SHALL use dark-compatible highlight colors
- **AND** the text SHALL remain readable

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: AbortError Console Noise Suppression
entries.text: The application SHALL NOT log `AbortError` exceptions to the console when they result from normal component unmounting lifecycle.

entries.heading: Spec: Touch Device UX > ADDED Requirements > Requirement: AbortError Console Noise Suppression > Scenario: Component unmounts during data fetch
entries.text:
- **WHEN** a Dashboard component or data-fetching hook is unmounted while an async operation is in progress
- **AND** the operation throws an `AbortError` (signal is aborted without reason)
- **THEN** the error SHALL be silently caught without logging to `console.error`
- **AND** other genuine errors SHALL continue to be logged normally

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Purpose
entries.text: TBD - created by archiving change security-architecture-hardening-v2. Update Purpose after archive.

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Production deployment exposes server-side security headers
entries.text:
系統 SHALL 透過 `vercel.json` 的 `headers` 區塊對所有路徑 `/(.*)` 注入 5 個伺服器端 HTTP 安全標頭：`Content-Security-Policy`、`X-Frame-Options: DENY`、`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`、`Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`、`Permissions-Policy`。這些標頭 SHALL 由伺服器（Vercel Edge）於回應 HTTP 請求時附加，而不是仰賴前端 `<meta http-equiv>` 標籤。

`<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` 標籤得以保留於 `index.html` 作為 dev 環境 fallback，但上方 SHALL 註記「優先由 vercel.json 提供；此 meta 僅為 dev fallback」。Production 部署的 CSP 來源 SHALL 為 `vercel.json`，且 SHALL 完整覆蓋 dev meta CSP 的所有指令。

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Production deployment exposes server-side security headers > Scenario: Server attaches all 5 security headers
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 任意 HTTP 請求抵達部署後的 Vercel 預覽或 production 環境
- **THEN** 回應標頭 SHALL 包含全部 5 個標頭（`Content-Security-Policy`、`X-Frame-Options`、`X-Content-Type-Options`、`Referrer-Policy`、`Permissions-Policy`）
- **AND** `X-Frame-Options` SHALL 為 `DENY`
- **AND** `X-Content-Type-Options` SHALL 為 `nosniff`
- **AND** `Referrer-Policy` SHALL 為 `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`
- **AND** `Permissions-Policy` SHALL 至少包含 `camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()` 三項鎖定

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Production deployment exposes server-side security headers > Scenario: vercel.json retains existing rewrites
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 讀取修改後的 `vercel.json`
- **THEN** 既有 `rewrites` 區塊（`/api/nvidia/:path*` → NVIDIA proxy，`/(.*)` → `/index.html`）SHALL 完整保留
- **AND** 新增的 `headers` 區塊 SHALL 不影響 `rewrites` 行為

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Content-Security-Policy connect-src fully whitelists production backends
entries.text:
`Content-Security-Policy` 的 `connect-src` 指令 SHALL 完整白名單所有 production 環境會發送網路請求的端點：本機同源 (`'self'`)、Supabase (`https://*.supabase.co`)、Google Gemini API (`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`)、OpenAI API (`https://api.openai.com`)、NVIDIA Integrate API (`https://integrate.api.nvidia.com`)。

當用戶需要配置自訂 AI Proxy 或 Local API 端點時，由於靜態 CSP 白名單之安全性限制，其 Proxy 域名需要在部署 `vercel.json` 前手動加入 `connect-src`。此設計邊界限制 SHALL 記錄於 `docs/SECURITY_LIMITATIONS.md`。

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Content-Security-Policy connect-src fully whitelists production backends > Scenario: connect-src includes OpenAI endpoint
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 解析 production `vercel.json` 中的 CSP 字串
- **THEN** `connect-src` SHALL 明確包含 `https://api.openai.com`
- **AND** SHALL 包含 `https://*.supabase.co`、`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`、`https://integrate.api.nvidia.com`
- **AND** SHALL 包含 `'self'`

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Content-Security-Policy connect-src fully whitelists production backends > Scenario: script-src forbids unsafe-eval
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 解析 production CSP 字串
- **THEN** `script-src` SHALL 為 `'self' 'unsafe-inline'`
- **AND** SHALL NOT 包含 `'unsafe-eval'`

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Content-Security-Policy connect-src fully whitelists production backends > Scenario: Dev meta CSP annotated as fallback
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 讀取 `index.html`
- **THEN** `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` 標籤上方 SHALL 註記「優先由 vercel.json 提供；此 meta 僅為 dev fallback；若有自訂 AI Proxy 需手動加白名單」
- **AND** 該 meta CSP 的 `connect-src` 亦 SHALL 包含 `https://api.openai.com`

entries.heading: vercel-security-headers Specification > Requirements > Requirement: Content-Security-Policy connect-src fully whitelists production backends > Scenario: Custom AI proxy limitation documented
entries.text:
- **WHEN** 讀取 `docs/SECURITY_LIMITATIONS.md`
- **THEN** 必須包含「靜態 CSP 限制自訂 API 域名，需要部署前手動修改 vercel.json connect-src」的安全性邊界說明。
